stopGap.retirementTrigger: Retire once TARGET Norn authoring (concept({ ... }), pinned packs) hosts the feature ontology natively in a Norn cell (#2005).

title: Core Engine & IR Semantics
summary: Canonical IR artifact kinds, exact value/quantity physics, concept graph/ontology, authorization, rules/decisions, laws/deontics, transactions/timers, and governed artifact lifecycle.

features.title: Approval fencing, hosted timers, and bounded commit-admission models

probe.drive: Inspect the bounded Quint/Apalache and Kani gate definitions in `verification/coverage-v1/promoted-gates.json` (run them in CI or a Boat sandbox, never local `cargo`/`rustc`), and drive an approval-gated action + self-approval refusal + reviewer approval and hosted timer dispatch against a local `norn dev` cell.
probe.observableEndState: Requester self-approval and stale-revision decisions fail closed with state unchanged; distinct reviewer approval commits atomically and fires scheduled timer/outbox work without duplicate execution.
gotchas: `hosted-timers-quint`, `hosted-timers-progress-quint`, and `approval-fencing-quint` are bounded Quint/Apalache model checks (5-step / 10-step bounds) and `kernel-version-kani` is a bounded Kani harness — evidence is `bounded`, never `checked-proof`.
Approval decisions are fenced against requester self-approval and stale revision; test with a distinct `--as reviewer` principal.

features.title: Governed artifact lifecycle, settings, packs, and labels

probe.drive: Inspect `direct_artifact_write_allowed` in `crates/norn-ir/src/lib.rs`, run `norn check --source tools/norn-ts/fixtures/quickstart --org example --env local`, and verify direct Approved/Active writes are refused unless routed through governed admission and install.
probe.observableEndState: Checker returns `admitted: true` with a deterministic `receiptSha256` for draft/proposed definitions, while direct persistence of Approved/Active authority-bearing artifacts is refused.
gotchas: Numeric settings (`valueType: "number"`) require exact `DecimalLiteral` strings (`PARAM-EXACT-1`), never binary64 numbers.
Labels (`ir:labels`) never participate in definition identity digests.

features.title: Atomic cell commits and lifecycle transition authority proofs

probe.drive: Submit an action with an idempotency key to a local `norn dev` cell (`POST /v1/actions/{actionId}`), replay the same idempotency key with identical and conflicting payloads, and verify stale-version CAS refusal; inspect Lean/Verus/Aeneas proof gates in `verification/coverage-v1/promoted-gates.json` (run formal gates in CI or a Boat sandbox).
probe.observableEndState: First call commits atomically and returns a receipt; identical replay returns the original receipt without duplicate effects; conflicting payload or stale revision refuses with state unchanged; all linked Lean/Verus/Aeneas gates hold without proof holes.
gotchas: Bounded Quint/Kani checks for approval fencing, hosted timers, and v2 commit admission live under `core-approval-fencing-and-timers` (`bounded`), separate from these unbounded Lean/Verus proofs.

probe.drive: Start a local `norn dev` cell with a named restricted principal (`norn.json` `dev.principals`), invoke a governed action with a missing role or mismatched org/env scope, then retry as an authorized principal.
probe.observableEndState: Unauthorized or out-of-scope requests fail closed with structured refusal diagnostics and leave cell state unchanged; authorized requests commit and return a receipt.
gotchas: The default loopback developer principal holds all roles (`DEV-LOOPBACK-1`); always test denials with a declared restricted principal or reviewer.

features.title: Derived views, predictive models, and checked UI widgets

probe.drive: Compile a fixture containing derived views, model metadata, and `W.widget` definitions via `norn compile`, then admit via `norn check` and verify `norn-ui-checker` Ring-1 admission rules.
probe.observableEndState: Admitted derived views remain pure/recompute-on-read with no IO, predictive models stay opaque outside authority paths, and invalid widget bindings fail admission deterministically.
gotchas: Projection correspondence across exact cell, IVM, and OLAP backends is tracked per backend profile; never treat a single-backend pass as full projection correspondence.

features.title: Scoped temporal laws, deontic norms, and exception precedence

probe.drive: Compile and check a pack defining `Norn.law`, `Norn.obligation`, `Norn.prohibition`, and `Norn.permission` via `norn check --source <pack>`, then inspect `norn explain law <id> --defs <artifacts> --format json`.
probe.observableEndState: Checker admits sound laws and rejects weakened inherited interface laws (`law.model.weakens_inherited`); `norn explain` reports explicit proof status without fabricating verified claims.
gotchas: Defeasible `unless` runtime commit evaluation and `severity: { override }` remain explicitly tracked engine gaps (`core.laws.unsupported_semantics`); report them honestly.

features.title: Concept graph, relations, connectors, source schemas, and mappings

probe.drive: Compile `tools/norn-ts/fixtures/core` with `norn compile tools/norn-ts/fixtures/core --org org_demo --env dev --out <tmp>/core.json` and run `norn check --artifacts <tmp>/core.json --context <tmp>/context.json`.
probe.observableEndState: Entity, relation, defined_concept, connector, source_schema, and mapping artifacts match canonical JSON IR (`fixtures/ir/synthetic-contact.source_schema.json`, `fixtures/ir/synthetic-rows.mapping.json`) and pass checker admission.
gotchas: Imported source rows remain evidence until promoted by a checked mapping/action; invalid rows quarantine as replay-stable `DataQualityFinding` records.

features.title: Exact quantity ledger, reservations, batches, units, and Cala boundary

probe.drive: Inspect the Lean/Quint/Kani gate definitions in `verification/coverage-v1/promoted-gates.json` for `quantity-ledger` and `core-physics`, and drive a balanced posting + over-reservation refusal against a local `norn dev` cell hosting an inventory/accounting pack.
probe.observableEndState: Balanced exact decimal postings commit atomically with conserved totals; unbalanced, unit-mismatched, or over-reserved mutations refuse with zero partial writes.
gotchas: Never use binary64 JSON numbers for quantities or money; exact string decimals are enforced at codec and storage boundaries.

features.title: Deterministic RuleIR decision tables and ZEN expression evaluation

probe.drive: Pipe JSON-lines inputs into `norn eval --defs <defs-dir> --org <org> --env <env> --rule <rule-id> --units 1000000` for an admitted RuleIR decision table (including a `UNIQUE` multi-match case).
probe.observableEndState: Deterministic JSON-lines output emits `{"ok":true,"closureDigest":...,"output":...}` for valid inputs and refuses multi-match `UNIQUE` or budget-exhausted inputs with `"ok":false`.
gotchas: Modulo `%` and host callbacks are rejected by `norn-zen/7`; default outputs apply only when zero rows match.
